systems.tiers: Consulted by court registries to verify a natural person's identity, as the alternative to examining the civil status registers, and a legal person's name (Articles 1289, 1290, 1292, 1324, 1327)

note: The criminal procedure code has court registries verify identity against the civil status registers or the CTDEC database before filing criminal-record entries; it says nothing on how births or deaths are registered.
